name: clangd-rerank
description: Reorders clangd completion items with a small local model (Sorter) and proposes names at declaration sites (Namer) through an LSP proxy. The preselected item is right 3x more often.

commands.title: clangd Rerank: Set Jev API key (TypeSafe)
clangd Rerank: Clear Jev API key
clangd Rerank: Show usage statistics (R@1 of what you actually typed)
clangd Rerank: Rewrite launcher and restart clangd

clangdRerank.enabled.description: Route clangd through the reranking proxy (sets clangd.path to the bundled launcher).

enumDescriptions: Local Kev server (python -m kev.serve --run <checkpoint>). Code never leaves the machine.
Jev hosted API (api.typesafe.ai). Sends the 40 lines before the cursor and the candidate names to TypeSafe. Needs an API key (command: Set Jev API key).
Only the feature-based LightGBM stage (2-3 ms, no model server). Weaker, but no dependencies.
clangdRerank.backend.description: Which third-stage model scores the candidates.

clangdRerank.localServerUrl.description: Base URL of the local Kev (System One compatible) server.

clangdRerank.generateUrl.description: 식별자 생성 서버 주소 (scripts/gen_server.py, 예: http://127.0.0.1:8010). 비우면 생성 끔. 선언 자리(`int `, `auto ` 뒤 등)에서만 새 이름 1~3개를 목록 맨 위에 ✦ 표시로 넣는다 (프로토타입).

clangdRerank.clangdPath.description: The real clangd executable the proxy launches. If clangd.path already pointed somewhere when the extension was enabled, that value is used.

clangdRerank.pythonPath.description: Python 3.9+ used to run the proxy. Standard library only, no packages needed.

clangdRerank.stage2ModelPath.description: LightGBM text model for stage 2. Empty = the bundled model.

clangdRerank.maxCandidates.description: How many stage-2 top candidates the model scores. 30 and 60 measured the same accuracy; 60 covers more positions.

clangdRerank.contextLines.description: Lines before the cursor sent to the model (40 measured best).

clangdRerank.timeoutMs.description: If the model does not answer in time, the stage-2 order (or clangd's order) is returned unchanged.

clangdRerank.setSuggestSelectionFirst.description: Set editor.suggestSelection to 'first' for C/C++ so VS Code's own 'recently used' memory does not undo the reranking (memory + reranking measured worse than reranking alone).

clangdRerank.recordStats.description: Record, for every completion site, the identifier you ended up writing and its rank in clangd's / stage-2 / final order (local JSONL in the extension's global storage; no code text). View with 'clangd Rerank: Show usage statistics'.
